body: On-device re-test after PRs #191 to #202 merged (feat/composer-editor-core at 3832126), Galaxy Note 10+, 2026-09-24 23:35 to 2026-09-25 00:02. Plain app built from a clean copy with no patch; probe with the testkit patch minus its Gradle hunk. Results are appended to ~/.mitosis/field-notes/testkit/E2E-REPORT.md, with evidence in results/android/verify/ (63 files). Fixed on device: B1, B2 (notification posted at 23:39:00), B3 (real app plus probe source, last and middle photo), B4 (clean debug build), H1 to H14, C1, C3 to C10. C2 only partly fixed: a blank line after the title now ends the lead, but a single line break (Enter once) still runs the title into the next sentence. The spec's assumption that C2's break is a blank line was too narrow. Remaining outside scope: screen-reader ticking of to-dos (checkbox nodes not clickable), the Today mood prompt node reads its question twice, the viewer edit button is unlabelled, and More formats items linger in the accessibility tree after the menu closes until the next tap (pre-existence not established). Not re-tested: audible sound, reminder after reboot, TalkBack speech. Cleanup: plain app emptied by Delete all with the reminder reset to 20:30; keep-awake watcher stopped; scratch worktrees removed.
